text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kokura Kinen is here. The
race has
many favorable conditions for
Найс Нэйчер, such
as its distance.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, it is precisely because of these
perfect
conditions that Найс Нэйчер feels
even more
pressure not to lose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер walks nervously into the
paddock as
the cheers of the people
from the Kokura
shopping district
shower down on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hearing their voices, she switches up her
attitude
and heads off to the race,
determined to meet
their expectations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
